items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the labelled theorem thm:w-hinit at source lines 524-526: for every A and every family B over A the W-algebra of the polynomial functor is homotopy-initial. The author's proof (source lines 528-562) is announced as a sketch and its hard step is not the existence of the homomorphism, which comes straight from W-elimination and the computation rule (source lines 536-537), but the contractibility of the type of homomorphisms. For that the proof replaces an identity of homomorphisms by the type of algebra 2-cells, pairs consisting of a homotopy between the underlying maps and a higher identity between two pasting diagrams printed as commuting squares (source lines 543-556), and it then has to build that homotopy by function extensionality together with W-elimination in such a way that the coherence datum exists as well (source lines 559-561). The statement contains neither the 2-cell reformulation nor the constraint that the homotopy has to be chosen to carry the coherence.
